title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 445 Main Street in Laceyville, Pennsylvania, as the Melinda Gene Piccotti Post Office.
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 445 Main Street in Laceyville, Pennsylvania, as the "Melinda Gene Piccotti Post Office."

summary.headline: Names the Postal Service facility at 445 Main Street in Laceyville, Pennsylvania, the Melinda Gene Piccotti Post Office.
summary.what_it_does: This law gives a specific Post Office building in Laceyville, Pennsylvania, an official name honoring Melinda Gene Piccotti. It changes only the designation of the building and does not create new rules, funding, or services. The official summary describes only the naming.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 21, 2020, and the designation took effect on that date.
